column1: # Exercise vocabulary for the compositional translation in translate.py.
# role: move (the exercise; gender m/f, plural mp/fp), of (target, right
# after the move), mod (adjective: masculine singular form, inflected for the
# move's gender and number; phrases with spaces are invariant), gear
# (equipment, last), skip (dropped). Longest phrase wins. A name with any word
# not covered here stays in English.
